competitiveTarget: Long-tail SEO: 'homes for sale in {zip}'. ZIPs carry no cached market row, so every stat is derived live from listing_tile_mv tiles (CLAUDE.md §0). KB design mirrors the city page pattern (Phase 9, docs/KB_CONVERGENCE_ROADMAP.md).
note: KB (kinetic-brutalist) rebuild 2026-06-18. ONE getZipListings(zip, {propertyType:'A', limit:5000}) call feeds the hero lede (active count, median list, median DOM), KbMarketHud (live tile stats + parent-city price history as trend source), KbFeatured (top 14 by price), KbListingMap, and two KbExploreTowns sections (subdivisions + other ZIPs). NO getMarketPulse/getMarketStats — there are no ZIP-keyed rows, nothing is fabricated. KbNav + KbFooter are the chrome (layout.tsx HideChrome does NOT fire for this route). Canonical 10 ZIPs, dynamicParams=false.
